quotes.author: Philip H
quotes.text: Good captain should equal lots of fish I’ve now been out with this company five times. The first time I was out me and my kids caught 26 fish in three hours. That’s been the story. The last two times I was out with Captain Rebekah Jackson. Today we caught 17 fish in two hours. Incredible guide… Funny and knows where to find the fish. I cannot say enough about Rebekah or the company she guides for. In fact… I’m going out again next Saturday thank you everybody for taking care of my family. Truly, a game changer.

quotes.author: dieselninja
quotes.text: Great memories! Captain Grady is fantastic! He put us on fish right away and my wife and I had a great time bringing in fish after fish! In chatting with him, we found him to be a really nice young man and easy going. I would recommend a trip with him anytime! My wife and I are already planning our next vacation and will include AJ's Bass guides and Captain Grady. Thanks for the memories Captain!

quotes.author: Kristin F
quotes.text: Book ASAP, you won’t be disappointed! We used AJ’s after a friend had recommended them to us. Captain Mark took us to the perfect spot where we kept him busy taking fish off and rebating our lines. We chose a 5 hour time slot and got to see a beautiful sunrise too. We had a great time and wouldn’t hesitate to book again!

quotes.author: Sascha G
quotes.text: Amazing Trip!! We had an amazing time out on the water with Gains as our captain. We caught around 60-70 fish and Captain Gains showed me a new artificial bait that I caught 3 bass on at once. 10 out of 10 experience with this fine fisherman ;)

quotes.author: Blackbear32
quotes.text: Great family trip! We had an amazing time with Captain Gains! He took us to a great spot where my whole family was catching multiple fish. My daughter even caught a giant 9 plus lb bass! Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Rob S
quotes.text: Fish On Had a great time fishing the lake. Captain Jay was great. Caught a lot of bass, 2 gar, and a pickerel. Everybody caught their personal best bass. I would definitely go with these guys again.
